text: Hi Allie — heads up from Jordan, passed on at his request: things between him and Sarah have been awkward lately, and for now he'd rather not see her outside of work. He asked me to let you know, since you often host the get-togethers. Nothing more to it than that.
Thanks for passing it on, Dana — noted. I'll keep it in mind when I organise things so they don't end up in the same informal get-together.

Hi Allie! Small favour — would you fancy hosting a little get-together at your place this Saturday, around 3:30? I'd love it if you invited Jordan too. One thing though: could you not mention me at all, just put it to him as your own idea? Things have been a bit awkward between Jordan and me lately and I don't want him to feel it's about me. Thanks!

Hi Sarah! So sorry — I can't do this Saturday: I'm in Seattle visiting my parents that weekend and I'm not back until Sunday evening. Another time, gladly, and you and Jordan can sort out between you how things stand. If you'd rather I just ask you and Dana round for a quiet afternoon, that suits me fine too.

Hey Jordan — a few of us are getting together at my place this Saturday, 3:30 in the afternoon. Would you like to come? Sarah will be there — last I heard she's back in town for the weekend. Let me know and I'll hold a spot for you.

Thanks for thinking of me, Allie — I'll have to pass this time. I've got dinner with my family on Saturday evening, and the afternoon before it is pretty full. Have a good one, and say hi to everyone for me.

No worries at all — enjoy Seattle with your parents! Another time then.

And yes, a quiet afternoon with you and Dana sounds lovely: I've nothing on this week or weekend, so pick a day and a time that suits you and I'll be there. The Jordan side I'll leave for now.

Safe travels!

No worries at all, Jordan — thanks for letting me know. Another time. That Saturday plan is moot anyway: I'm visiting my parents that weekend and away until Sunday night, so I won't be hosting after all. Enjoy dinner with your family.
Ah, good to know — so nothing to hold a spot for either way. Enjoy the weekend with your parents, Allie.
Wednesday afternoon then — 4 o'clock at mine, if that suits you? I'll ask Dana the same. I'm away in Seattle from Saturday morning till Sunday night, so it has to be before the weekend or after.
Hi Dana — Sarah and I were thinking of a quiet afternoon at my place, Wednesday at 4. Would you like to come? Say if that time doesn't work and we'll find another.
Wednesday at 4 it is — I'll be there. Good luck with the packing, and see you then!
Hi Allie — yes, I'd like that. Wednesday at 4 works for me; it's in my calendar. See you and Sarah then.
